whyThisFailureMatters: It demonstrates that name-level novelty is not semantic novelty.
It shows the experiment pipeline can preserve an unfavorable preregistered result instead of moving goalposts.
It exposed and corrected an implementation bug before receipt promotion.
It generated a reusable requirement for all future ontology/primitive claims.

mandatoryNextGate.rule: Before a target may be called missing from an existing finite representation system, compare its behavior against the existing candidate family over a declared fixture universe and report exact equivalence plus nearest distance.
mandatoryNextGate.boundary: Passing a finite preflight establishes non-equivalence only on the declared fixtures, not universal novelty.
